paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a,
heading: Zawlnei Taklou Pasalte Kalh A Thugen
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel zawlnei, amah lungtang kia a kipan a gen chingte tung ah thu gen inla, 'TOUPA thu ngai un.' "
english: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word:

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, "Zawlnei hai, amau ngaihdan zui a, bangmah muloute tung agik hi!
english: The Lord Yahweh says, “Woe to the foolish prophets, who follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

paite: Aw Israel, na zawlneite khopi sesa a sehal om bang lel ahita uh.
english: Israel, your prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.

paite: TOUPA ni a kidouna a dingzou ding a kulhbaang dingkipsak ding leh Israel inkote hum ding a kulhbaang lam ding in na paitou kei uhi."
english: You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in Yahweh’s day.

paite: "TOUPA thupawt ahi," chi mite'n bangmah lou lel leh genkholhna lim lel atang ua, TOUPA sawl ahi kei uh; athu uh hi ngei ding bang in mite agingtasak ua.
english: They have seen falsehood and lying divination, who say, ‘Yahweh says;’ but Yahweh has not sent them. They have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.

paite: Kilakna hong vuaksuak lel na mu un, thugenkholh diklou na gen uh ahi kei maw? "TOUPA thupawt ahi," na chi nawn ngal ua, ke'n ka gen a hia?
english: Haven’t you seen a false vision, and haven’t you spoken a lying divination, in that you say, ‘Yahweh says;’ but I have not spoken?”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Bangmah lou phet na gen ua zuau lel na muh ziak un, ngai un, ka hon nang ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Because you have spoken falsehood and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Huan ka khut in bangmah lou mute leh zuau genkhol mite anang ding a, ka mite kidotkhawmna ah atel kei ding ua, Israel inkuante min gelhna ah gelh in a-om sam kei ding uh; huchi in Toupa PATHIAN ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: “My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and who utter lying divinations. They will not be in the council of my people, neither will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither will they enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”

paite: Galmuanna omloupi ma, "Muanna," chi a mite apimang ziak un leh mi baang bawl a, sunu nuh mite'n,
english: “‘Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, “Peace;” and there is no peace. When one builds up a wall, behold, they plaster it with whitewash.

paite: "Ake nawn mai ding, vuahpi ahong zu ding a, nou gial lianpite aw, na hong ke ding ua, huih thupi in ahihse ding," chi in.
english: Tell those who plaster it with whitewash that it will fall. There will be an overflowing shower; and you, great hailstones, will fall. A stormy wind will tear it.

paite: Ngai un, baang achip khit chiang in, "Na sunu nuh uh koi ah, ahon chi kei ding ua hia?"
english: Behold, when the wall has fallen, won’t it be said to you, “Where is the plaster with which you have plastered it?”

paite: "Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ka heh in huihpi thupi in ka hihse vek ding, ka heh in vuahpi ahong zu ding a, ka heh in gial thupitak hihmang ding in ahong ke ding.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “I will even tear it with a stormy wind in my wrath. There will be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.

paite: Huchi in sunu na nuhngou bang uh ka chimsak ding a, lei pha in achim dia, huchi in asuangphumte adawk hial ding hi; huan achim ding a, baang kichim ah hihmang in na om ding uh; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: So I will break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered. It will fall, and you will be consumed in the middle of it. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: "Hichibang in baang tung ah leh sunu nuh mite tung ah ka hehna ka damsak ding; huan, baang a-om nawn kei a, abaang zutte leng a-om nawnta kei uh, ka hon chi ding hi.
english: Thus I will accomplish my wrath on the wall, and on those who have plastered it with whitewash. I will tell you, ‘The wall is no more, nor those who plastered it—

paite: Huai bel Israel zawlnei Jerusalem tungthu gen a, galmuanna omloupi a galmuanna musak mite ngei, a-om nawn kei uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: to wit, the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace,’” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: "Nang mihing tapa, na mite tanute, alungtang lel ua gen mite masuan inla, amaute kalh in thu gen in, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi:
heading: Numei Zawlnei Dikloute Kalh A Genkholhna
english: You, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy against them,

paite: Numei, mite ban a sik bunsak leh mi hinnate mat belhna ding a miliante lukhuhna khui mite atung uh agik hi! Nou hinna ding in ka mite hinna na man ding uh maw?
english: and say, “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Woe to the women who sew magic bands on all elbows and make veils for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people and save souls alive for yourselves?

paite: Buhman tawmchik leh tanghou them mu ding a si lou ding sisak ding leh hing lou ding hingsak ding in na zuaugen uh ka mite'n a-up ziak un ka mite lak ah ka min athanghuai ahi.
english: You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who should not die and to save the souls alive who should not live, by your lying to my people who listen to lies.’

paite: "Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, mi hinna, vasa bang a man ding a na thil butsakte uh ka mudah ahi; na bante uh ka bot ding a, na mimat dingte uh vasa bang a na mat dingte uh hinna ka pawtsak vek ding hi.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I am against your magic bands, with which you hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms. I will let the souls fly free, even the souls whom you ensnare like birds.

paite: Na lukhuhnate uh leng ka botkek ding a, ka mite na khut ua kipan ka suaktasak ding, na mat theih ding un na khut uah a-omta kei ding uh; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: I will also tear your veils and deliver my people out of your hand; and they will no longer be in your hand to be ensnared. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: "Kei lungkhamsak hilou a, midiktatte lungtang zuau a na hihnat ziak un leh migilou hingdam a a-omna ding a akhelhna lampi a kipan akilehheilouhna ding in migilou khutte na hihhat uh ahi.
english: Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive.

paite: Huaiziak in bangmah lou lel, thugenkholh diklou hiam zaw na mu nawn kei ding uh; huan na khut ua kipan ka mite ka hunkhe ding a, TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh, achi, chi in gen in," achi high in," achi hi.
english: Therefore you shall no more see false visions nor practice divination. I will deliver my people out of your hand. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’”
